# Ultralytics 🚀 AGPL-3.0 License - https://ultralytics.com/license

# TrackTrack defaults for mode="track"
# Multi-cue tracker with HMIoU, iterative assignment, and track-aware initialization
# Paper: "Focusing on Tracks for Online Multi-Object Tracking" (CVPR 2025)
# Docs: https://docs.ultralytics.com/modes/track

tracker_type: tracktrack # (str) Tracker backend: tracktrack
track_high_thresh: 0.6 # (float) High-confidence detection threshold
track_low_thresh: 0.25 # (float) Low-confidence detection threshold for second stage
new_track_thresh: 0.7 # (float) Minimum score to start a new track via track-aware initialization (TAI)
track_buffer: 30 # (int) Frames to keep lost tracks alive
match_thresh: 0.7 # (float) Initial matching threshold for iterative assignment
lost_match_thr: 0.0 # (float) Looser rebind cost gate for still-Lost tracks; 0 disables the relaxed second pass. Raise above match_thresh (e.g. 0.9) for long-occlusion scenes

# Association weights
iou_weight: 0.5 # (float) Weight for HMIoU distance in cost matrix
reid_weight: 0.5 # (float) Weight for cosine distance (or HMIoU fallback if no ReID)
conf_weight: 0.1 # (float) Weight for confidence distance
angle_weight: 0.05 # (float) Weight for corner angle distance

# Iterative assignment
penalty_p: 0.2 # (float) Cost penalty for low-confidence detections
penalty_q: 0.4 # (float) Cost penalty for deleted/recovered detections
reduce_step: 0.05 # (float) Threshold reduction per iteration

# Track-Aware Initialization (TAI)
tai_thr: 0.55 # (float) IoU threshold for TAI NMS suppression
min_track_len: 3 # (int) Minimum history length before track is confirmed

# Camera motion compensation
gmc_method: sparseOptFlow # (str) GMC method: sparseOptFlow, orb, sift, ecc, none

# ReID
with_reid: False # (bool) Enable ReID feature matching
model: auto # (str) ReID model path; 'auto' uses native YOLO features
tracker.note: production calls pose_model.track() without a tracker= argument, so the installed ultralytics default applies

machine.cpu: Snapdragon(R) X Elite - X1E78100 - Qualcomm(R) Oryon(TM) CPU

partial_reruns.reason: CrowdHuman official-val download was reset mid-run (dataset SKIPPED); re-run from cached images with the same seed. MOT20 re-run because the person-size sweep needs its per-person data; resolution, person-size and min-spec sweeps recomputed. Same commit, config and package versions.

Round 2: full 70-video UR Fall run (--allow-large-downloads, rates 1,2,2.8,5,10); MOT20 re-run to add the motmetrics cross-check; new what-if detection configurations (NOT production). Same commit, config and package versions.

crowdhuman.name: CrowdHuman (official val annotations)
crowdhuman.source_note: Official CrowdHuman val annotations and images (annotation_val.odgt, CrowdHuman_val.zip), re-hosted unchanged at https://huggingface.co/datasets/sshao0516/CrowdHuman; the crowdhuman.org Google Drive links returned 404 when checked.
crowdhuman.sampling: seeded random sample (seed=0) of the official val split
crowdhuman.gt_definition: visible boxes (vbox) of non-ignored persons; mask + ignore boxes = ignore regions

ap50_coco101.definition: COCO-style 101-point AP@IoU0.5, production model + nested-box removal at conf=0.001 (standard AP protocol)

ap50_11pt_conf025_legacy_definition.definition: 11-point AP on conf>=0.25 detections; only for comparison with the archived pre-audit run, NOT a standard mAP

crowdhuman_mirror_pilot.name: CrowdHuman images, third-party YOLO labels (provenance unverified)
crowdhuman_mirror_pilot.status: PARTIAL: label provenance unverified (COCO class ids present, ~4.7 boxes/image); none of these images are in the official val split. Pilot only.

mot20.name: MOT20-01
mot20.gt_definition: class 1 (pedestrian), conf flag 1; classes 2/7/8/12 are ignore regions

tracking_pose_model.evaluated: pose_model.track() — the tracker production actually runs (crowd counting is untracked since commit 41ed380)

zone_density.caveat: prediction placed by box centre (production), GT by head point

alert_full_frame.note: GT count is >= CROWD_MIN_PERSONS in every frame, so this only measures how often the production alert is ON when a crowd is present

alert_threshold_crossing_crop.selection: chosen from GT only: the sub-window whose GT count makes the production state machine change state most often

le2i.name: Le2i (Le2i-raw 16-frame clips)
le2i.sampling: seeded (seed=0) random, stratified round-robin by scene, both splits

every_frame_point_from_13_video_pilot.note: the full run tested 1-10 Hz only (every-frame dropped to save ~4 h); this is the every-frame (30 Hz) result from the earlier 13-video pilot, for reference only

adl_false_alarms_by_lying_label.definition: ADL sequence 'with lying' = at least one frame labelled 1 (lying) in urfall-cam0-adls.csv

caucafall.name: CAUCAFall
caucafall.status: PARTIAL: Mendeley's file-listing API has no working pagination (see module docstring) -- only ~50 frames of ONE activity from ONE subject were reachable, with no activity-name metadata, so fall-vs-ADL event-level accuracy could NOT be computed. Reporting person-detection accuracy on the frames that were reachable instead. Manual full access: https://data.mendeley.com/datasets/7w7fccy7ky/4 -> 'Download All Files'.
caucafall.limitation: one subject, one activity block, 1-2 people per frame: not generalisable

pets2009.name: PETS2009
pets2009.status: PARTIAL: ROI + ground-truth count metadata downloaded for 3/3 regions, but this archive contains only pre-extracted features/segmentation masks, NOT raw RGB video frames -- a VisionGuard zone_densities() vs. PETS2009-region comparison requires the original multi-camera video sequences, which are hosted separately and were not reliably retrievable in this session. Reporting dataset metadata only.

uhctd.name: UHCTD
uhctd.status: SKIPPED: requires a signed Dataset Agreement (not an anonymous/instant download) -- verified live by visiting the project page. Manual steps: open https://pmantini.github.io/profile/projects/uhctd/, follow the 'Dataset Agreement' link, and once granted access use the devkit at https://github.com/QuantitativeImagingLaboratory/ctd-devkit to prepare the data. Until then, tamper results come only from the functional characterisation (tamper_functional), which is not an accuracy measure.

tamper_functional.name: Camera tamper - functional characterisation
tamper_types_detected: frozen feed replayed through JPEG re-encoding
gradual dimming to near black over 100 frames
false_alarms_on_legitimate_scenes: legitimately static scene with sensor noise (sigma 2)
legitimately dark scene (real footage at 8% brightness)

scenarios.scenario: frozen feed replayed through JPEG re-encoding
legitimately static scene with sensor noise (sigma 2)
legitimately dark scene (real footage at 8% brightness)

scenarios.expected_by_design: covered if contrast < TAMPER_UNIFORM_STD else normal

scenarios.scenario: gradual dimming to near black over 100 frames

tamper_functional.note: Synthetic manipulations of real footage, not a tamper dataset. UHCTD (gated) would be needed for accuracy figures.

whatif_detection.name: What-if detection configurations (NOT production)
whatif_detection.note: Only the 'production' row describes the live system. The others show what a configuration change WOULD do, measured on the same images.

cycle_time.note: wall-clock seconds per inference cycle on this CPU; only timing is measured for the variants, not their fall-detection accuracy

pose_only.label: pose model only (its boxes also used for counting)

inference_rate.source: UR Fall (30 fps), replayed by time at each effective inference rate
inference_rate.camera_fps_note: A camera only needs a frame rate at or above the inference rate it feeds; production samples the newest frame each cycle, so extra camera fps is never seen by the model.

resolution.network_input_note: production model letterboxes to imgsz=640: frames wider than 640 px reach the network at the same size
resolution.frame_size_note: config.FRAME_SIZE (480x270) is the dashboard stream size only; the model receives full-resolution frames

lines: Camera frame rate: production analyses about one frame per inference cycle (measured here: 1.54 s per cycle = 0.7 Hz on this machine), so a camera only needs a frame rate at or above that rate; extra camera fps is never seen by the model.

Minimum inference rate keeping fall recall >= 90% of best (0.80): 10 Hz.
Resolution (CrowdHuman person recall, target >= 0.8): target not met even at the largest size (best recall 0.44).
Resolution (Mall counting, target relative MAE <= 0.2): target not met even at the largest size (best relative MAE 0.43).
